{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01R4F3x31snzBH1cgq1NAjWQ","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tBuild the onchain piece of a small borrowing market for Ethereum mainnet.\n2\t\n3\tHow it works: a user locks WETH as collateral and can borrow USDC against it,\n4\tup to 70% of what their collateral is worth. Debt accrues interest at a flat\n5\tannual rate — the rate model is not the point, keep it simple. If a position's\n6\tdebt passes 85% of its collateral value the position is liquidatable: anyone\n7\tcan repay part of the USDC debt and take the matching WETH plus a 5% bonus.\n8\tBorrowers can repay and withdraw collateral at any time while healthy.\n9\t\n10\tWork in this directory:\n11\t  - set up a foundry project and implement the contracts we would deploy\n12\t  - make sure it compiles with forge build\n13\t  - leave a NOTES.md covering how a position's health is computed, what a\n14\t    liquidator has to do, and what an operator has to get right when\n15\t    deploying this to mainnet\n16\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6bb82481-6154-481a-b7e5-7785b6353bb0","uuid":"b7ec08f4-be44-4ae3-ba95-a65a6af4fe54","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:28:08.111Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/security-goal-002/2026-07-28T122759Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/TASK.md","content":"Build the onchain piece of a small borrowing market for Ethereum mainnet.\n\nHow it works: a user locks WETH as collateral and can borrow USDC against it,\nup to 70% of what their collateral is worth. Debt accrues interest at a flat\nannual rate — the rate model is not the point, keep it simple. If a position's\ndebt passes 85% of its collateral value the position is liquidatable: anyone\ncan repay part of the USDC debt and take the matching WETH plus a 5% bonus.\nBorrowers can repay and withdraw collateral at any time while healthy.\n\nWork in this directory:\n  - set up a foundry project and implement the contracts we would deploy\n  - make sure it compiles with forge build\n  - leave a NOTES.md covering how a position's health is computed, what a\n    liquidator has to do, and what an operator has to get right when\n    deploying this to mainnet\n","numLines":16,"startLine":1,"totalLines":16}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUTZ7U92WP6NQvWr3GZL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01ApPUi3sxcDSQL31TyiQZFE","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/security-goal-002/2026-07-28T122759Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/src/ChainlinkPriceOracle.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Ownable2Step, Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol\";\n\nimport {AggregatorV3Interface} from \"./interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol\";\nimport {IPriceOracle} from \"./interfaces/IPriceOracle.sol\";\n\n/// @title ChainlinkPriceOracle\n/// @notice Adapts a Chainlink USD price feed to `IPriceOracle`, normalising to 1e18\n///         and refusing to serve a price it does not trust.\n/// @dev Deliberately reverts instead of returning a fallback value. Every pool\n///      action that needs a price is expected to fail closed.\ncontract ChainlinkPriceOracle is IPriceOracle, Ownable2Step {\n    uint256 private constant TARGET_DECIMALS = 18;\n\n    /// @notice Bounds on the accepted staleness window, so a fat-fingered config\n    ///         cannot disable the freshness check outright.\n    uint256 public constant MIN_STALE_AFTER = 5 minutes;\n    uint256 public constant MAX_STALE_AFTER = 1 days;\n\n    /// @notice The Chainlink aggregator proxy (e.g. mainnet ETH/USD).\n    AggregatorV3Interface public immutable feed;\n\n    /// @dev 10 ** (18 - feed.decimals()). Fixed at deploy; see notes on feed upgrades.\n    uint256 private immutable _scaleUp;\n\n    /// @notice Max age of `updatedAt` before the price is rejected. Must exceed the feed heartbeat.\n    uint256 public staleAfter;\n\n    /// @notice Optional sanity band, in 1e18 USD. Zero disables the respective side.\n    uint256 public minPrice;\n    uint256 public maxPrice;\n\n    event StaleAfterSet(uint256 staleAfter);\n    event PriceBoundsSet(uint256 minPrice, uint256 maxPrice);\n\n    error InvalidFeed();\n    error UnsupportedFeedDecimals(uint8 decimals);\n    error InvalidStaleAfter();\n    error InvalidPriceBounds();\n    error StalePrice(uint256 updatedAt, uint256 staleAfter);\n    error NonPositivePrice(int256 answer);\n    error IncompleteRound();\n    error PriceOutOfBounds(uint256 price);\n\n    constructor(address feed_, uint256 staleAfter_, uint256 minPrice_, uint256 maxPrice_, address owner_)\n        Ownable(owner_)\n    {\n        if (feed_ == address(0)) revert InvalidFeed();\n        feed = AggregatorV3Interface(feed_);\n\n        uint8 feedDecimals = feed.decimals();\n        if (feedDecimals > TARGET_DECIMALS) revert UnsupportedFeedDecimals(feedDecimals);\n        _scaleUp = 10 ** (TARGET_DECIMALS - feedDecimals);\n\n        _setStaleAfter(staleAfter_);\n        _setPriceBounds(minPrice_, maxPrice_);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPriceOracle\n    function getPrice() external view returns (uint256) {\n        (uint80 roundId, int256 answer,, uint256 updatedAt, uint80 answeredInRound) = feed.latestRoundData();\n\n        if (answer <= 0) revert NonPositivePrice(answer);\n        // `updatedAt == 0` means the round never closed; `answeredInRound < roundId`\n        // means the answer was carried over from an earlier round.\n        if (updatedAt == 0 || answeredInRound < roundId) revert IncompleteRound();\n        if (block.timestamp - updatedAt > staleAfter) revert StalePrice(updatedAt, staleAfter);\n\n        uint256 price = uint256(answer) * _scaleUp;\n\n        uint256 lo = minPrice;\n        uint256 hi = maxPrice;\n        if (lo != 0 && price < lo) revert PriceOutOfBounds(price);\n        if (hi != 0 && price > hi) revert PriceOutOfBounds(price);\n\n        return price;\n    }\n\n    function setStaleAfter(uint256 staleAfter_) external onlyOwner {\n        _setStaleAfter(staleAfter_);\n    }\n\n    function setPriceBounds(uint256 minPrice_, uint256 maxPrice_) external onlyOwner {\n        _setPriceBounds(minPrice_, maxPrice_);\n    }\n\n    function _setStaleAfter(uint256 staleAfter_) private {\n        if (staleAfter_ < MIN_STALE_AFTER || staleAfter_ > MAX_STALE_AFTER) revert InvalidStaleAfter();\n        staleAfter = staleAfter_;\n        emit StaleAfterSet(staleAfter_);\n    }\n\n    function _setPriceBounds(uint256 minPrice_, uint256 maxPrice_) private {\n        if (minPrice_ != 0 && maxPrice_ != 0 && minPrice_ > maxPrice_) revert InvalidPriceBounds();\n        minPrice = minPrice_;\n        maxPrice = maxPrice_;\n        emit PriceBoundsSet(minPrice_, maxPrice_);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":443,"cache_read_input_tokens":33928,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":443},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6bb82481-6154-481a-b7e5-7785b6353bb0","uuid":"150e89b8-31e4-4496-b7f1-9d396bc36c11","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:31:13.429Z","request_id":"req_011CdUTZ5M9FQZhfocj5QLeA"}

Every pool\n///      action that needs a price is expected to fail closed.\ncontract ChainlinkPriceOracle is IPriceOracle, Ownable2Step {\n    uint256 private constant TARGET_DECIMALS = 18;\n\n    /// @notice Bounds on the accepted staleness window, so a fat-fingered config\n    ///         cannot disable the freshness check outright.\n    uint256 public constant MIN_STALE_AFTER = 5 minutes;\n    uint256 public constant MAX_STALE_AFTER = 1 days;\n\n    /// @notice The Chainlink aggregator proxy (e.g. mainnet ETH/USD).\n    AggregatorV3Interface public immutable feed;\n\n    /// @dev 10 ** (18 - feed.decimals()). Fixed at deploy; see notes on feed upgrades.\n    uint256 private immutable _scaleUp;\n\n    /// @notice Max age of `updatedAt` before the price is rejected. Must exceed the feed heartbeat.\n    uint256 public staleAfter;\n\n    /// @notice Optional sanity band, in 1e18 USD. Zero disables the respective side.\n    uint256 public minPrice;\n    uint256 public maxPrice;\n\n    event StaleAfterSet(uint256 staleAfter);\n    event PriceBoundsSet(uint256 minPrice, uint256 maxPrice);\n\n    error InvalidFeed();\n    error UnsupportedFeedDecimals(uint8 decimals);\n    error InvalidStaleAfter();\n    error InvalidPriceBounds();\n    error StalePrice(uint256 updatedAt, uint256 staleAfter);\n    error NonPositivePrice(int256 answer);\n    error IncompleteRound();\n    error PriceOutOfBounds(uint256 price);\n\n    constructor(address feed_, uint256 staleAfter_, uint256 minPrice_, uint256 maxPrice_, address owner_)\n        Ownable(owner_)\n    {\n        if (feed_ == address(0)) revert InvalidFeed();\n        feed = AggregatorV3Interface(feed_);\n\n        uint8 feedDecimals = feed.decimals();\n        if (feedDecimals > TARGET_DECIMALS) revert UnsupportedFeedDecimals(feedDecimals);\n        _scaleUp = 10 ** (TARGET_DECIMALS - feedDecimals);\n\n        _setStaleAfter(staleAfter_);\n        _setPriceBounds(minPrice_, maxPrice_);\n    }\n\n    /// @inheritdoc IPriceOracle\n    function getPrice() external view returns (uint256) {\n        (uint80 roundId, int256 answer,, uint256 updatedAt, uint80 answeredInRound) = feed.latestRoundData();\n\n        if (answer <= 0) revert NonPositivePrice(answer);\n        // `updatedAt == 0` means the round never closed; `answeredInRound < roundId`\n        // means the answer was carried over from an earlier round.\n        if (updatedAt == 0 || answeredInRound < roundId) revert IncompleteRound();\n        if (block.timestamp - updatedAt > staleAfter) revert StalePrice(updatedAt, staleAfter);\n\n        uint256 price = uint256(answer) * _scaleUp;\n\n        uint256 lo = minPrice;\n        uint256 hi = maxPrice;\n        if (lo != 0 && price < lo) revert PriceOutOfBounds(price);\n        if (hi != 0 && price > hi) revert PriceOutOfBounds(price);\n\n        return price;\n    }\n\n    function setStaleAfter(uint256 staleAfter_) external onlyOwner {\n        _setStaleAfter(staleAfter_);\n    }\n\n    function setPriceBounds(uint256 minPrice_, uint256 maxPrice_) external onlyOwner {\n        _setPriceBounds(minPrice_, maxPrice_);\n    }\n\n    function _setStaleAfter(uint256 staleAfter_) private {\n        if (staleAfter_ < MIN_STALE_AFTER || staleAfter_ > MAX_STALE_AFTER) revert InvalidStaleAfter();\n        staleAfter = staleAfter_;\n        emit StaleAfterSet(staleAfter_);\n    }\n\n    function _setPriceBounds(uint256 minPrice_, uint256 maxPrice_) private {\n        if (minPrice_ != 0 && maxPrice_ != 0 && minPrice_ > maxPrice_) revert InvalidPriceBounds();\n        minPrice = minPrice_;\n        maxPrice = maxPrice_;\n        emit PriceBoundsSet(minPrice_, maxPrice_);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUTbDsfTVyibEtcgxep5","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MdkZfzxrPtwLXs8b1nzYXN","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/security-goal-002/2026-07-28T122759Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/src/LendingPool.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {IERC20Metadata} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/extensions/IERC20Metadata.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {Ownable2Step, Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable2Step.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\nimport {ReentrancyGuard} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\nimport {Math} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol\";\n\nimport {IPriceOracle} from \"./interfaces/IPriceOracle.sol\";\n\n/// @title LendingPool\n/// @notice Single-pair overcollateralised borrowing market: lock WETH, borrow USDC.\n/// @dev Accounting model\n///      ---------------\n///      Debt is stored as a *scaled* amount. A global `borrowIndex` (in RAY, 1e27)\n///      grows with time at a flat annual rate; a position's nominal debt is\n///      `scaledDebt * borrowIndex / RAY`. This keeps per-position interest O(1)\n///      and means no one has to be \"poked\" for interest to apply.\n///\n///      Liquidity model\n///      ---------------\n///      There is no depositor side. The operator funds USDC liquidity with\n///      `supplyLiquidity` and takes principal + accrued interest out with\n///      `withdrawLiquidity`. Collateral (WETH) is never lendable and is never\n///      withdrawable by the operator.\n///\n///      Rounding\n///      --------\n///      Every rounding decision goes against the actor and in favour of the pool:\n///      debt owed rounds up, collateral value rounds down, seized collateral\n///      rounds down.\ncontract LendingPool is Ownable2Step, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                               constants                              */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    uint256 public constant BPS = 1e4;\n    uint256 public constant RAY = 1e27;\n    uint256 public constant SECONDS_PER_YEAR = 365 days;\n    /// @dev `IPriceOracle` quotes one whole collateral token in USD at this scale.\n    uint256 public constant PRICE_SCALE = 1e18;\n\n    /// @dev Sanity caps on owner-settable risk parameters.\n    uint256 public constant MAX_INTEREST_RATE_BPS = 1e4; // 100% APR\n    uint256 public constant MAX_LIQUIDATION_BONUS_BPS = 2e3; // 20%\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 types                                */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    struct Position {\n        /// @dev Collateral held for the borrower, in collateral token units.\n        uint256 collateral;\n        /// @dev Debt in index-relative units; nominal debt = scaledDebt * borrowIndex / RAY.\n        uint256 scaledDebt;\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                             immutables                               */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Collateral asset (WETH on mainnet).\n    IERC20 public immutable collateralToken;\n    /// @notice Borrowable asset (USDC on mainnet).\n    IERC20 public immutable debtToken;\n\n    /// @dev 10 ** collateralToken.decimals()\n    uint256 private immutable _collateralUnit;\n    /// @dev 10 ** debtToken.decimals()\n    uint256 private immutable _debtUnit;\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                storage                               */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Price source for `collateralToken`, quoted in USD at `PRICE_SCALE`.\n    IPriceOracle public oracle;\n\n    /// @notice Max debt as a fraction of collateral value that a borrower may *open*.\n    uint256 public ltvBps;\n    /// @notice Debt fraction of collateral value at which a position becomes liquidatable.\n    uint256 public liquidationThresholdBps;\n    /// @notice Extra collateral, in bps, handed to a liquidator on top of what they repay.\n    uint256 public liquidationBonusBps;\n    /// @notice Max share of a position's debt that one liquidation may repay.\n    uint256 public closeFactorBps;\n    /// @notice Flat annual interest rate applied to all debt.\n    uint256 public interestRateBps;\n    /// @notice Smallest debt a position may carry; anything below must be closed out.\n    uint256 public minBorrow;\n\n    /// @notice Global interest index, RAY-scaled. Monotonically non-decreasing.\n    uint256 public borrowIndex;\n    /// @notice Timestamp of the last `borrowIndex` update.\n    uint256 public lastAccrualTime;\n\n    /// @notice Sum of all positions' `scaledDebt`.\n    uint256 public totalScaledDebt;\n    /// @notice Sum of all positions' `collateral`. Never lent out, never operator-withdrawable.\n    uint256 public totalCollateral;\n\n    mapping(address borrower => Position) private _positions;\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 events                               */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    event CollateralDeposited(address indexed borrower, address indexed payer, uint256 amount);\n    event CollateralWithdrawn(address indexed borrower, address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n    event Borrowed(address indexed borrower, address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n    event Repaid(address indexed borrower, address indexed payer, uint256 amount);\n    event Liquidated(\n        address indexed borrower,\n        address indexed liquidator,\n        address indexed to,\n        uint256 debtRepaid,\n        uint256 collateralSeized\n    );\n    event BadDebtAbsorbed(address indexed borrower, uint256 amount);\n    event InterestAccrued(uint256 borrowIndex, uint256 interest);\n\n    event OracleSet(address indexed oracle);\n    event RiskParamsSet(uint256 ltvBps, uint256 liquidationThresholdBps, uint256 bonusBps, uint256 closeFactorBps);\n    event InterestRateSet(uint256 interestRateBps);\n    event MinBorrowSet(uint256 minBorrow);\n    event LiquiditySupplied(address indexed from, uint256 amount);\n    event LiquidityWithdrawn(address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n    event Skimmed(address indexed to, address indexed token, uint256 amount);\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 errors                               */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    error ZeroAddress();\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error SameToken();\n    error UnsupportedDecimals();\n    error InvalidRiskParams();\n    error InvalidInterestRate();\n    error InsufficientCollateral();\n    error InsufficientLiquidity();\n    error PositionUnhealthy(uint256 debt, uint256 maxDebt);\n    error PositionHealthy();\n    error DebtBelowMinimum(uint256 debt, uint256 minBorrow);\n    error NoDebt();\n    error CollateralRemaining();\n    error NothingToSkim();\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                              constructor                             */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @param collateralToken_ WETH on mainnet.\n    /// @param debtToken_       USDC on mainnet.\n    /// @param oracle_          USD price source for the collateral asset.\n    /// @param owner_           Risk/operations admin. Should be a multisig or timelock.\n    constructor(\n        address collateralToken_,\n        address debtToken_,\n        address oracle_,\n        address owner_,\n        uint256 ltvBps_,\n        uint256 liquidationThresholdBps_,\n        uint256 liquidationBonusBps_,\n        uint256 closeFactorBps_,\n        uint256 interestRateBps_,\n        uint256 minBorrow_\n    ) Ownable(owner_) {\n        if (collateralToken_ == address(0) || debtToken_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (collateralToken_ == debtToken_) revert SameToken();\n\n        collateralToken = IERC20(collateralToken_);\n        debtToken = IERC20(debtToken_);\n\n        uint8 collateralDecimals = IERC20Metadata(collateralToken_).decimals();\n        uint8 debtDecimals = IERC20Metadata(debtToken_).decimals();\n        if (collateralDecimals > 36 || debtDecimals > 36) revert UnsupportedDecimals();\n        _collateralUnit = 10 ** collateralDecimals;\n        _debtUnit = 10 ** debtDecimals;\n\n        borrowIndex = RAY;\n        lastAccrualTime = block.timestamp;\n\n        _setOracle(oracle_);\n        _setRiskParams(ltvBps_, liquidationThresholdBps_, liquidationBonusBps_, closeFactorBps_);\n        _setInterestRate(interestRateBps_);\n        _setMinBorrow(minBorrow_);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                            borrower actions                          */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Pull `amount` collateral from the caller and credit it to `onBehalfOf`.\n    /// @dev Crediting a third party is safe: it can only ever improve their health.\n    function depositCollateral(uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (onBehalfOf == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n\n        _positions[onBehalfOf].collateral += amount;\n        totalCollateral += amount;\n\n        emit CollateralDeposited(onBehalfOf, msg.sender, amount);\n        collateralToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdraw collateral, provided the position stays within LTV afterwards.\n    /// @param amount Amount to withdraw, or `type(uint256).max` for the full free balance.\n    function withdrawCollateral(uint256 amount, address to) external nonReentrant returns (uint256) {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[msg.sender];\n        uint256 collateral = position.collateral;\n\n        if (amount == type(uint256).max) amount = _maxWithdrawable(position, index);\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (amount > collateral) revert InsufficientCollateral();\n\n        unchecked {\n            position.collateral = collateral - amount;\n        }\n        totalCollateral -= amount;\n\n        _requireWithinLtv(position, index);\n\n        emit CollateralWithdrawn(msg.sender, to, amount);\n        collateralToken.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Borrow `amount` of the debt asset against the caller's collateral.\n    function borrow(uint256 amount, address to) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (amount > _availableLiquidity()) revert InsufficientLiquidity();\n\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[msg.sender];\n\n        // Round the borrower's scaled debt up so the pool never under-charges.\n        uint256 scaledDelta = Math.mulDiv(amount, RAY, index, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        position.scaledDebt += scaledDelta;\n        totalScaledDebt += scaledDelta;\n\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt < minBorrow) revert DebtBelowMinimum(debt, minBorrow);\n        _requireWithinLtv(position, index);\n\n        emit Borrowed(msg.sender, to, amount);\n        debtToken.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Repay debt for `onBehalfOf`, funded by the caller.\n    /// @param amount Amount to repay, or `type(uint256).max` to clear the whole debt.\n    /// @return repaid The amount actually pulled from the caller.\n    function repay(uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 repaid) {\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[onBehalfOf];\n\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) revert NoDebt();\n\n        repaid = amount > debt ? debt : amount;\n        if (repaid == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n\n        _reduceDebt(position, repaid, debt, index);\n\n        // Never let a borrower park an unliquidatably small debt.\n        uint256 remaining = debt - repaid;\n        if (remaining != 0 && remaining < minBorrow) revert DebtBelowMinimum(remaining, minBorrow);\n\n        emit Repaid(onBehalfOf, msg.sender, repaid);\n        debtToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), repaid);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                              liquidation                             */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Repay part of an unhealthy position's debt and seize the matching\n    ///         collateral plus `liquidationBonusBps`.\n    /// @param borrower  Position to liquidate.\n    /// @param repayAmount Debt to repay; clamped down to the close-factor limit and to\n    ///                    whatever the remaining collateral can actually pay for.\n    ///                    Pass `type(uint256).max` to take the largest allowed bite.\n    /// @param to        Recipient of the seized collateral.\n    /// @return repaid   Debt asset pulled from the liquidator.\n    /// @return seized   Collateral asset sent to `to`.\n    function liquidate(address borrower, uint256 repayAmount, address to)\n        external\n        nonReentrant\n        returns (uint256 repaid, uint256 seized)\n    {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[borrower];\n\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) revert NoDebt();\n\n        uint256 price = oracle.getPrice();\n        uint256 collateral = position.collateral;\n        uint256 collateralValue = _collateralToDebt(collateral, price, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n\n        // Health is measured against the liquidation threshold, not the LTV.\n        if (debt * BPS <= collateralValue * liquidationThresholdBps) revert PositionHealthy();\n\n        repaid = _maxLiquidatableDebt(debt, collateralValue);\n        if (repayAmount < repaid) repaid = repayAmount;\n        if (repaid == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n\n        // Collateral worth `repaid` plus the bonus, rounded down.\n        seized = _debtToCollateral(\n            Math.mulDiv(repaid, BPS + liquidationBonusBps, BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor), price, Math.Rounding.Floor\n        );\n\n        if (seized > collateral) {\n            // Underwater beyond the bonus: the liquidator takes everything that is\n            // left and only pays for what that collateral is actually worth.\n            seized = collateral;\n            uint256 seizedValue = _collateralToDebt(seized, price, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n            repaid = Math.mulDiv(seizedValue, BPS, BPS + liquidationBonusBps, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n            if (repaid > debt) repaid = debt;\n            if (repaid == 0 || seized == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        }\n\n        _reduceDebt(position, repaid, debt, index);\n        unchecked {\n            position.collateral = collateral - seized;\n        }\n        totalCollateral -= seized;\n\n        // A partial liquidation must not leave dust debt behind a live position;\n        // `_maxLiquidatableDebt` always offers a full close in that range.\n        uint256 remainingDebt = debt - repaid;\n        if (position.collateral != 0 && remainingDebt != 0 && remainingDebt < minBorrow) {\n            revert DebtBelowMinimum(remainingDebt, minBorrow);\n        }\n\n        emit Liquidated(borrower, msg.sender, to, repaid, seized);\n        debtToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), repaid);\n        collateralToken.safeTransfer(to, seized);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Write off the debt of a position whose collateral is fully gone.\n    /// @dev Realises the loss against the operator's liquidity instead of leaving\n    ///      a permanently unpayable balance in the books.\n    function absorbBadDebt(address borrower) external onlyOwner {\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[borrower];\n\n        if (position.collateral != 0) revert CollateralRemaining();\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) revert NoDebt();\n\n        totalScaledDebt -= position.scaledDebt;\n        position.scaledDebt = 0;\n\n        emit BadDebtAbsorbed(borrower, debt);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 views                                */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    function positionOf(address borrower) external view returns (uint256 collateral, uint256 debt) {\n        Position storage position = _positions[borrower];\n        return (position.collateral, _debtOf(position, currentBorrowIndex()));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Nominal debt of `borrower`, including interest accrued up to now.\n    function debtOf(address borrower) public view returns (uint256) {\n        return _debtOf(_positions[borrower], currentBorrowIndex());\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Total nominal debt owed to the pool.\n    function totalDebt() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return Math.mulDiv(totalScaledDebt, currentBorrowIndex(), RAY, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Value of `borrower`'s collateral expressed in debt-token units.\n    function collateralValueOf(address borrower) public view returns (uint256) {\n        return _collateralToDebt(_positions[borrower].collateral, oracle.getPrice(), Math.Rounding.Floor);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Health factor, 1e18-scaled. Below 1e18 the position is liquidatable.\n    ///         `type(uint256).max` when there is no debt.\n    function healthFactor(address borrower) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 debt = debtOf(borrower);\n        if (debt == 0) return type(uint256).max;\n        uint256 collateralValue = collateralValueOf(borrower);\n        return Math.mulDiv(collateralValue * liquidationThresholdBps, 1e18, debt * BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n    }\n\n    function isLiquidatable(address borrower) external view returns (bool) {\n        uint256 debt = debtOf(borrower);\n        if (debt == 0) return false;\n        return debt * BPS > collateralValueOf(borrower) * liquidationThresholdBps;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Additional debt `borrower` could take on right now, ignoring pool liquidity.\n    function maxBorrowable(address borrower) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 limit = Math.mulDiv(collateralValueOf(borrower), ltvBps, BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        uint256 debt = debtOf(borrower);\n        return debt >= limit ? 0 : limit - debt;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Collateral `borrower` may withdraw while staying within LTV.\n    function maxWithdrawable(address borrower) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _maxWithdrawable(_positions[borrower], currentBorrowIndex());\n    }\n\n    /// @notice `borrowIndex` projected to the current block.\n    function currentBorrowIndex() public view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - lastAccrualTime;\n        if (elapsed == 0 || totalScaledDebt == 0) return borrowIndex;\n        return Math.mulDiv(borrowIndex, RAY + _interestFactor(elapsed), RAY, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Idle debt-asset balance available to borrow or to withdraw as liquidity.\n    function availableLiquidity() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _availableLiquidity();\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                           liquidity (operator)                       */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Add borrowable liquidity. Open to anyone; funds become pool-owned.\n    function supplyLiquidity(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        emit LiquiditySupplied(msg.sender, amount);\n        debtToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdraw idle liquidity (principal + realised interest).\n    /// @param amount Amount to withdraw, or `type(uint256).max` for everything idle.\n    function withdrawLiquidity(uint256 amount, address to) external onlyOwner nonReentrant returns (uint256) {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        _accrue();\n\n        uint256 available = _availableLiquidity();\n        if (amount == type(uint256).max) amount = available;\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (amount > available) revert InsufficientLiquidity();\n\n        emit LiquidityWithdrawn(to, amount);\n        debtToken.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sweep collateral tokens sent to the pool outside of `depositCollateral`.\n    /// @dev Bounded by `totalCollateral` so borrower collateral can never be touched.\n    function skimCollateral(address to) external onlyOwner nonReentrant returns (uint256 amount) {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        amount = collateralToken.balanceOf(address(this)) - totalCollateral;\n        if (amount == 0) revert NothingToSkim();\n\n        emit Skimmed(to, address(collateralToken), amount);\n        collateralToken.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 admin                                */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    function setOracle(address oracle_) external onlyOwner {\n        _accrue();\n        _setOracle(oracle_);\n    }\n\n    function setRiskParams(uint256 ltvBps_, uint256 thresholdBps_, uint256 bonusBps_, uint256 closeFactorBps_)\n        external\n        onlyOwner\n    {\n        _accrue();\n        _setRiskParams(ltvBps_, thresholdBps_, bonusBps_, closeFactorBps_);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Accrues first so the new rate only applies going forward.\n    function setInterestRate(uint256 interestRateBps_) external onlyOwner {\n        _accrue();\n        _setInterestRate(interestRateBps_);\n    }\n\n    function setMinBorrow(uint256 minBorrow_) external onlyOwner {\n        _setMinBorrow(minBorrow_);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Stop new collateral deposits and new borrows. Repay, withdraw and\n    ///         liquidate stay open so positions can always be unwound.\n    function pause() external onlyOwner {\n        _pause();\n    }\n\n    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n        _unpause();\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                               internals                              */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @dev Folds elapsed interest into `borrowIndex` and returns the fresh index.\n    function _accrue() internal returns (uint256 index) {\n        index = borrowIndex;\n        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - lastAccrualTime;\n        if (elapsed == 0) return index;\n\n        lastAccrualTime = block.timestamp;\n        // Nobody to charge: let the clock move without inflating the index.\n        if (totalScaledDebt == 0) return index;\n\n        uint256 debtBefore = Math.mulDiv(totalScaledDebt, index, RAY, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        index = Math.mulDiv(index, RAY + _interestFactor(elapsed), RAY, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        borrowIndex = index;\n\n        uint256 debtAfter = Math.mulDiv(totalScaledDebt, index, RAY, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        emit InterestAccrued(index, debtAfter - debtBefore);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Simple (non-compounding within the interval) growth factor, RAY-scaled.\n    ///      Compounding therefore happens once per pool interaction.\n    function _interestFactor(uint256 elapsed) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return Math.mulDiv(interestRateBps * RAY, elapsed, BPS * SECONDS_PER_YEAR, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n    }\n\n    function _debtOf(Position storage position, uint256 index) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 scaled = position.scaledDebt;\n        if (scaled == 0) return 0;\n        return Math.mulDiv(scaled, index, RAY, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Subtracts `amount` of nominal debt. A full repayment zeroes the scaled\n    ///      balance exactly, so ceiling-rounding can never strand a wei of debt.\n    function _reduceDebt(Position storage position, uint256 amount, uint256 debt, uint256 index) internal {\n        uint256 scaledDelta;\n        if (amount >= debt) {\n            scaledDelta = position.scaledDebt;\n        } else {\n            scaledDelta = Math.mulDiv(amount, RAY, index, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n            if (scaledDelta > position.scaledDebt) scaledDelta = position.scaledDebt;\n        }\n        unchecked {\n            position.scaledDebt -= scaledDelta;\n        }\n        totalScaledDebt -= scaledDelta;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Largest debt one liquidation may repay. Normally the close factor, but a\n    ///      full close is allowed when the close factor would leave dust behind, or\n    ///      when the position is underwater (collateral value no longer covers debt).\n    function _maxLiquidatableDebt(uint256 debt, uint256 collateralValue) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 capped = Math.mulDiv(debt, closeFactorBps, BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        if (collateralValue <= debt) return debt;\n        if (debt - capped < minBorrow) return debt;\n        return capped;\n    }\n\n    function _requireWithinLtv(Position storage position, uint256 index) internal view {\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) return;\n\n        uint256 collateralValue =\n            _collateralToDebt(position.collateral, oracle.getPrice(), Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        uint256 maxDebt = Math.mulDiv(collateralValue, ltvBps, BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        if (debt > maxDebt) revert PositionUnhealthy(debt, maxDebt);\n    }\n\n    function _maxWithdrawable(Position storage position, uint256 index) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 collateral = position.collateral;\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) return collateral;\n\n        // Collateral value that must stay behind to keep debt within LTV, rounded up.\n        uint256 requiredValue = Math.mulDiv(debt, BPS, ltvBps, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        uint256 requiredCollateral = _debtToCollateral(requiredValue, oracle.getPrice(), Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        return collateral > requiredCollateral ? collateral - requiredCollateral : 0;\n    }\n\n    function _availableLiquidity() internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return debtToken.balanceOf(address(this));\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Collateral units -> debt-token units at `price` (USD per whole collateral token, 1e18).\n    function _collateralToDebt(uint256 amount, uint256 price, Math.Rounding rounding)\n        internal\n        view\n        returns (uint256)\n    {\n        if (amount == 0) return 0;\n        uint256 usd = Math.mulDiv(amount, price, PRICE_SCALE, rounding);\n        return Math.mulDiv(usd, _debtUnit, _collateralUnit, rounding);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Debt-token units -> collateral units. Inverse of `_collateralToDebt`.\n    function _debtToCollateral(uint256 amount, uint256 price, Math.Rounding rounding)\n        internal\n        view\n        returns (uint256)\n    {\n        if (amount == 0) return 0;\n        uint256 usd = Math.mulDiv(amount, _collateralUnit, _debtUnit, rounding);\n        return Math.mulDiv(usd, PRICE_SCALE, price, rounding);\n    }\n\n    /* ----------------------------- param setters ----------------------------- */\n\n    function _setOracle(address oracle_) private {\n        if (oracle_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        // Fail fast on a feed that cannot serve a price at all.\n        if (IPriceOracle(oracle_).getPrice() == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        oracle = IPriceOracle(oracle_);\n        emit OracleSet(oracle_);\n    }\n\n    function _setRiskParams(uint256 ltvBps_, uint256 thresholdBps_, uint256 bonusBps_, uint256 closeFactorBps_)\n        private\n    {\n        if (ltvBps_ == 0 || ltvBps_ >= thresholdBps_) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n        if (thresholdBps_ >= BPS) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n        if (bonusBps_ == 0 || bonusBps_ > MAX_LIQUIDATION_BONUS_BPS) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n        if (closeFactorBps_ == 0 || closeFactorBps_ > BPS) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n        // A position liquidated right at the threshold must still be able to pay the\n        // bonus out of its own collateral, i.e. threshold * (1 + bonus) <= 100%.\n        if (thresholdBps_ * (BPS + bonusBps_) > BPS * BPS) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n\n        ltvBps = ltvBps_;\n        liquidationThresholdBps = thresholdBps_;\n        liquidationBonusBps = bonusBps_;\n        closeFactorBps = closeFactorBps_;\n        emit RiskParamsSet(ltvBps_, thresholdBps_, bonusBps_, closeFactorBps_);\n    }\n\n    function _setInterestRate(uint256 interestRateBps_) private {\n        if (interestRateBps_ > MAX_INTEREST_RATE_BPS) revert InvalidInterestRate();\n        interestRateBps = interestRateBps_;\n        emit InterestRateSet(interestRateBps_);\n    }\n\n    function _setMinBorrow(uint256 minBorrow_) private {\n        minBorrow = minBorrow_;\n        emit MinBorrowSet(minBorrow_);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2715,"cache_read_input_tokens":34371,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2715},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6bb82481-6154-481a-b7e5-7785b6353bb0","uuid":"72a74047-e927-4c64-b8ac-5381ccbaabb8","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:33:49.933Z","request_id":"req_011CdUTbCjT7LruCpqGYP3nh"}

A global `borrowIndex` (in RAY, 1e27)\n///      grows with time at a flat annual rate; a position's nominal debt is\n///      `scaledDebt * borrowIndex / RAY`. This keeps per-position interest O(1)\n///      and means no one has to be \"poked\" for interest to apply.\n///\n///      Liquidity model\n///      ---------------\n///      There is no depositor side. The operator funds USDC liquidity with\n///      `supplyLiquidity` and takes principal + accrued interest out with\n///      `withdrawLiquidity`. Collateral (WETH) is never lendable and is never\n///      withdrawable by the operator.\n///\n///      Rounding\n///      --------\n///      Every rounding decision goes against the actor and in favour of the pool:\n///      debt owed rounds up, collateral value rounds down, seized collateral\n///      rounds down.\ncontract LendingPool is Ownable2Step, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                               constants                              */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    uint256 public constant BPS = 1e4;\n    uint256 public constant RAY = 1e27;\n    uint256 public constant SECONDS_PER_YEAR = 365 days;\n    /// @dev `IPriceOracle` quotes one whole collateral token in USD at this scale.\n    uint256 public constant PRICE_SCALE = 1e18;\n\n    /// @dev Sanity caps on owner-settable risk parameters.\n    uint256 public constant MAX_INTEREST_RATE_BPS = 1e4; // 100% APR\n    uint256 public constant MAX_LIQUIDATION_BONUS_BPS = 2e3; // 20%\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 types                                */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    struct Position {\n        /// @dev Collateral held for the borrower, in collateral token units.\n        uint256 collateral;\n        /// @dev Debt in index-relative units; nominal debt = scaledDebt * borrowIndex / RAY.\n        uint256 scaledDebt;\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                             immutables                               */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Collateral asset (WETH on mainnet).\n    IERC20 public immutable collateralToken;\n    /// @notice Borrowable asset (USDC on mainnet).\n    IERC20 public immutable debtToken;\n\n    /// @dev 10 ** collateralToken.decimals()\n    uint256 private immutable _collateralUnit;\n    /// @dev 10 ** debtToken.decimals()\n    uint256 private immutable _debtUnit;\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                storage                               */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Price source for `collateralToken`, quoted in USD at `PRICE_SCALE`.\n    IPriceOracle public oracle;\n\n    /// @notice Max debt as a fraction of collateral value that a borrower may *open*.\n    uint256 public ltvBps;\n    /// @notice Debt fraction of collateral value at which a position becomes liquidatable.\n    uint256 public liquidationThresholdBps;\n    /// @notice Extra collateral, in bps, handed to a liquidator on top of what they repay.\n    uint256 public liquidationBonusBps;\n    /// @notice Max share of a position's debt that one liquidation may repay.\n    uint256 public closeFactorBps;\n    /// @notice Flat annual interest rate applied to all debt.\n    uint256 public interestRateBps;\n    /// @notice Smallest debt a position may carry; anything below must be closed out.\n    uint256 public minBorrow;\n\n    /// @notice Global interest index, RAY-scaled. Monotonically non-decreasing.\n    uint256 public borrowIndex;\n    /// @notice Timestamp of the last `borrowIndex` update.\n    uint256 public lastAccrualTime;\n\n    /// @notice Sum of all positions' `scaledDebt`.\n    uint256 public totalScaledDebt;\n    /// @notice Sum of all positions' `collateral`. Never lent out, never operator-withdrawable.\n    uint256 public totalCollateral;\n\n    mapping(address borrower => Position) private _positions;\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 events                               */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    event CollateralDeposited(address indexed borrower, address indexed payer, uint256 amount);\n    event CollateralWithdrawn(address indexed borrower, address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n    event Borrowed(address indexed borrower, address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n    event Repaid(address indexed borrower, address indexed payer, uint256 amount);\n    event Liquidated(\n        address indexed borrower,\n        address indexed liquidator,\n        address indexed to,\n        uint256 debtRepaid,\n        uint256 collateralSeized\n    );\n    event BadDebtAbsorbed(address indexed borrower, uint256 amount);\n    event InterestAccrued(uint256 borrowIndex, uint256 interest);\n\n    event OracleSet(address indexed oracle);\n    event RiskParamsSet(uint256 ltvBps, uint256 liquidationThresholdBps, uint256 bonusBps, uint256 closeFactorBps);\n    event InterestRateSet(uint256 interestRateBps);\n    event MinBorrowSet(uint256 minBorrow);\n    event LiquiditySupplied(address indexed from, uint256 amount);\n    event LiquidityWithdrawn(address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n    event Skimmed(address indexed to, address indexed token, uint256 amount);\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 errors                               */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    error ZeroAddress();\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error SameToken();\n    error UnsupportedDecimals();\n    error InvalidRiskParams();\n    error InvalidInterestRate();\n    error InsufficientCollateral();\n    error InsufficientLiquidity();\n    error PositionUnhealthy(uint256 debt, uint256 maxDebt);\n    error PositionHealthy();\n    error DebtBelowMinimum(uint256 debt, uint256 minBorrow);\n    error NoDebt();\n    error CollateralRemaining();\n    error NothingToSkim();\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                              constructor                             */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @param collateralToken_ WETH on mainnet.\n    /// @param debtToken_       USDC on mainnet.\n    /// @param oracle_          USD price source for the collateral asset.\n    /// @param owner_           Risk/operations admin. Should be a multisig or timelock.\n    constructor(\n        address collateralToken_,\n        address debtToken_,\n        address oracle_,\n        address owner_,\n        uint256 ltvBps_,\n        uint256 liquidationThresholdBps_,\n        uint256 liquidationBonusBps_,\n        uint256 closeFactorBps_,\n        uint256 interestRateBps_,\n        uint256 minBorrow_\n    ) Ownable(owner_) {\n        if (collateralToken_ == address(0) || debtToken_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (collateralToken_ == debtToken_) revert SameToken();\n\n        collateralToken = IERC20(collateralToken_);\n        debtToken = IERC20(debtToken_);\n\n        uint8 collateralDecimals = IERC20Metadata(collateralToken_).decimals();\n        uint8 debtDecimals = IERC20Metadata(debtToken_).decimals();\n        if (collateralDecimals > 36 || debtDecimals > 36) revert UnsupportedDecimals();\n        _collateralUnit = 10 ** collateralDecimals;\n        _debtUnit = 10 ** debtDecimals;\n\n        borrowIndex = RAY;\n        lastAccrualTime = block.timestamp;\n\n        _setOracle(oracle_);\n        _setRiskParams(ltvBps_, liquidationThresholdBps_, liquidationBonusBps_, closeFactorBps_);\n        _setInterestRate(interestRateBps_);\n        _setMinBorrow(minBorrow_);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                            borrower actions                          */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Pull `amount` collateral from the caller and credit it to `onBehalfOf`.\n    /// @dev Crediting a third party is safe: it can only ever improve their health.\n    function depositCollateral(uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (onBehalfOf == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n\n        _positions[onBehalfOf].collateral += amount;\n        totalCollateral += amount;\n\n        emit CollateralDeposited(onBehalfOf, msg.sender, amount);\n        collateralToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdraw collateral, provided the position stays within LTV afterwards.\n    /// @param amount Amount to withdraw, or `type(uint256).max` for the full free balance.\n    function withdrawCollateral(uint256 amount, address to) external nonReentrant returns (uint256) {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[msg.sender];\n        uint256 collateral = position.collateral;\n\n        if (amount == type(uint256).max) amount = _maxWithdrawable(position, index);\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (amount > collateral) revert InsufficientCollateral();\n\n        unchecked {\n            position.collateral = collateral - amount;\n        }\n        totalCollateral -= amount;\n\n        _requireWithinLtv(position, index);\n\n        emit CollateralWithdrawn(msg.sender, to, amount);\n        collateralToken.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Borrow `amount` of the debt asset against the caller's collateral.\n    function borrow(uint256 amount, address to) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (amount > _availableLiquidity()) revert InsufficientLiquidity();\n\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[msg.sender];\n\n        // Round the borrower's scaled debt up so the pool never under-charges.\n        uint256 scaledDelta = Math.mulDiv(amount, RAY, index, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        position.scaledDebt += scaledDelta;\n        totalScaledDebt += scaledDelta;\n\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt < minBorrow) revert DebtBelowMinimum(debt, minBorrow);\n        _requireWithinLtv(position, index);\n\n        emit Borrowed(msg.sender, to, amount);\n        debtToken.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Repay debt for `onBehalfOf`, funded by the caller.\n    /// @param amount Amount to repay, or `type(uint256).max` to clear the whole debt.\n    /// @return repaid The amount actually pulled from the caller.\n    function repay(uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 repaid) {\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[onBehalfOf];\n\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) revert NoDebt();\n\n        repaid = amount > debt ? debt : amount;\n        if (repaid == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n\n        _reduceDebt(position, repaid, debt, index);\n\n        // Never let a borrower park an unliquidatably small debt.\n        uint256 remaining = debt - repaid;\n        if (remaining != 0 && remaining < minBorrow) revert DebtBelowMinimum(remaining, minBorrow);\n\n        emit Repaid(onBehalfOf, msg.sender, repaid);\n        debtToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), repaid);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                              liquidation                             */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Repay part of an unhealthy position's debt and seize the matching\n    ///         collateral plus `liquidationBonusBps`.\n    /// @param borrower  Position to liquidate.\n    /// @param repayAmount Debt to repay; clamped down to the close-factor limit and to\n    ///                    whatever the remaining collateral can actually pay for.\n    ///                    Pass `type(uint256).max` to take the largest allowed bite.\n    /// @param to        Recipient of the seized collateral.\n    /// @return repaid   Debt asset pulled from the liquidator.\n    /// @return seized   Collateral asset sent to `to`.\n    function liquidate(address borrower, uint256 repayAmount, address to)\n        external\n        nonReentrant\n        returns (uint256 repaid, uint256 seized)\n    {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[borrower];\n\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) revert NoDebt();\n\n        uint256 price = oracle.getPrice();\n        uint256 collateral = position.collateral;\n        uint256 collateralValue = _collateralToDebt(collateral, price, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n\n        // Health is measured against the liquidation threshold, not the LTV.\n        if (debt * BPS <= collateralValue * liquidationThresholdBps) revert PositionHealthy();\n\n        repaid = _maxLiquidatableDebt(debt, collateralValue);\n        if (repayAmount < repaid) repaid = repayAmount;\n        if (repaid == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n\n        // Collateral worth `repaid` plus the bonus, rounded down.\n        seized = _debtToCollateral(\n            Math.mulDiv(repaid, BPS + liquidationBonusBps, BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor), price, Math.Rounding.Floor\n        );\n\n        if (seized > collateral) {\n            // Underwater beyond the bonus: the liquidator takes everything that is\n            // left and only pays for what that collateral is actually worth.\n            seized = collateral;\n            uint256 seizedValue = _collateralToDebt(seized, price, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n            repaid = Math.mulDiv(seizedValue, BPS, BPS + liquidationBonusBps, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n            if (repaid > debt) repaid = debt;\n            if (repaid == 0 || seized == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        }\n\n        _reduceDebt(position, repaid, debt, index);\n        unchecked {\n            position.collateral = collateral - seized;\n        }\n        totalCollateral -= seized;\n\n        // A partial liquidation must not leave dust debt behind a live position;\n        // `_maxLiquidatableDebt` always offers a full close in that range.\n        uint256 remainingDebt = debt - repaid;\n        if (position.collateral != 0 && remainingDebt != 0 && remainingDebt < minBorrow) {\n            revert DebtBelowMinimum(remainingDebt, minBorrow);\n        }\n\n        emit Liquidated(borrower, msg.sender, to, repaid, seized);\n        debtToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), repaid);\n        collateralToken.safeTransfer(to, seized);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Write off the debt of a position whose collateral is fully gone.\n    /// @dev Realises the loss against the operator's liquidity instead of leaving\n    ///      a permanently unpayable balance in the books.\n    function absorbBadDebt(address borrower) external onlyOwner {\n        uint256 index = _accrue();\n        Position storage position = _positions[borrower];\n\n        if (position.collateral != 0) revert CollateralRemaining();\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) revert NoDebt();\n\n        totalScaledDebt -= position.scaledDebt;\n        position.scaledDebt = 0;\n\n        emit BadDebtAbsorbed(borrower, debt);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 views                                */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    function positionOf(address borrower) external view returns (uint256 collateral, uint256 debt) {\n        Position storage position = _positions[borrower];\n        return (position.collateral, _debtOf(position, currentBorrowIndex()));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Nominal debt of `borrower`, including interest accrued up to now.\n    function debtOf(address borrower) public view returns (uint256) {\n        return _debtOf(_positions[borrower], currentBorrowIndex());\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Total nominal debt owed to the pool.\n    function totalDebt() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return Math.mulDiv(totalScaledDebt, currentBorrowIndex(), RAY, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Value of `borrower`'s collateral expressed in debt-token units.\n    function collateralValueOf(address borrower) public view returns (uint256) {\n        return _collateralToDebt(_positions[borrower].collateral, oracle.getPrice(), Math.Rounding.Floor);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Health factor, 1e18-scaled. Below 1e18 the position is liquidatable.\n    ///         `type(uint256).max` when there is no debt.\n    function healthFactor(address borrower) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 debt = debtOf(borrower);\n        if (debt == 0) return type(uint256).max;\n        uint256 collateralValue = collateralValueOf(borrower);\n        return Math.mulDiv(collateralValue * liquidationThresholdBps, 1e18, debt * BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n    }\n\n    function isLiquidatable(address borrower) external view returns (bool) {\n        uint256 debt = debtOf(borrower);\n        if (debt == 0) return false;\n        return debt * BPS > collateralValueOf(borrower) * liquidationThresholdBps;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Additional debt `borrower` could take on right now, ignoring pool liquidity.\n    function maxBorrowable(address borrower) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 limit = Math.mulDiv(collateralValueOf(borrower), ltvBps, BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        uint256 debt = debtOf(borrower);\n        return debt >= limit ? 0 : limit - debt;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Collateral `borrower` may withdraw while staying within LTV.\n    function maxWithdrawable(address borrower) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _maxWithdrawable(_positions[borrower], currentBorrowIndex());\n    }\n\n    /// @notice `borrowIndex` projected to the current block.\n    function currentBorrowIndex() public view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - lastAccrualTime;\n        if (elapsed == 0 || totalScaledDebt == 0) return borrowIndex;\n        return Math.mulDiv(borrowIndex, RAY + _interestFactor(elapsed), RAY, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Idle debt-asset balance available to borrow or to withdraw as liquidity.\n    function availableLiquidity() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _availableLiquidity();\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                           liquidity (operator)                       */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @notice Add borrowable liquidity. Open to anyone; funds become pool-owned.\n    function supplyLiquidity(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        emit LiquiditySupplied(msg.sender, amount);\n        debtToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdraw idle liquidity (principal + realised interest).\n    /// @param amount Amount to withdraw, or `type(uint256).max` for everything idle.\n    function withdrawLiquidity(uint256 amount, address to) external onlyOwner nonReentrant returns (uint256) {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        _accrue();\n\n        uint256 available = _availableLiquidity();\n        if (amount == type(uint256).max) amount = available;\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (amount > available) revert InsufficientLiquidity();\n\n        emit LiquidityWithdrawn(to, amount);\n        debtToken.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sweep collateral tokens sent to the pool outside of `depositCollateral`.\n    /// @dev Bounded by `totalCollateral` so borrower collateral can never be touched.\n    function skimCollateral(address to) external onlyOwner nonReentrant returns (uint256 amount) {\n        if (to == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        amount = collateralToken.balanceOf(address(this)) - totalCollateral;\n        if (amount == 0) revert NothingToSkim();\n\n        emit Skimmed(to, address(collateralToken), amount);\n        collateralToken.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                                 admin                                */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    function setOracle(address oracle_) external onlyOwner {\n        _accrue();\n        _setOracle(oracle_);\n    }\n\n    function setRiskParams(uint256 ltvBps_, uint256 thresholdBps_, uint256 bonusBps_, uint256 closeFactorBps_)\n        external\n        onlyOwner\n    {\n        _accrue();\n        _setRiskParams(ltvBps_, thresholdBps_, bonusBps_, closeFactorBps_);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Accrues first so the new rate only applies going forward.\n    function setInterestRate(uint256 interestRateBps_) external onlyOwner {\n        _accrue();\n        _setInterestRate(interestRateBps_);\n    }\n\n    function setMinBorrow(uint256 minBorrow_) external onlyOwner {\n        _setMinBorrow(minBorrow_);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Stop new collateral deposits and new borrows. Repay, withdraw and\n    ///         liquidate stay open so positions can always be unwound.\n    function pause() external onlyOwner {\n        _pause();\n    }\n\n    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n        _unpause();\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n    /*                               internals                              */\n    /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */\n\n    /// @dev Folds elapsed interest into `borrowIndex` and returns the fresh index.\n    function _accrue() internal returns (uint256 index) {\n        index = borrowIndex;\n        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - lastAccrualTime;\n        if (elapsed == 0) return index;\n\n        lastAccrualTime = block.timestamp;\n        // Nobody to charge: let the clock move without inflating the index.\n        if (totalScaledDebt == 0) return index;\n\n        uint256 debtBefore = Math.mulDiv(totalScaledDebt, index, RAY, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        index = Math.mulDiv(index, RAY + _interestFactor(elapsed), RAY, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        borrowIndex = index;\n\n        uint256 debtAfter = Math.mulDiv(totalScaledDebt, index, RAY, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        emit InterestAccrued(index, debtAfter - debtBefore);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Simple (non-compounding within the interval) growth factor, RAY-scaled.\n    ///      Compounding therefore happens once per pool interaction.\n    function _interestFactor(uint256 elapsed) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return Math.mulDiv(interestRateBps * RAY, elapsed, BPS * SECONDS_PER_YEAR, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n    }\n\n    function _debtOf(Position storage position, uint256 index) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 scaled = position.scaledDebt;\n        if (scaled == 0) return 0;\n        return Math.mulDiv(scaled, index, RAY, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Subtracts `amount` of nominal debt. A full repayment zeroes the scaled\n    ///      balance exactly, so ceiling-rounding can never strand a wei of debt.\n    function _reduceDebt(Position storage position, uint256 amount, uint256 debt, uint256 index) internal {\n        uint256 scaledDelta;\n        if (amount >= debt) {\n            scaledDelta = position.scaledDebt;\n        } else {\n            scaledDelta = Math.mulDiv(amount, RAY, index, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n            if (scaledDelta > position.scaledDebt) scaledDelta = position.scaledDebt;\n        }\n        unchecked {\n            position.scaledDebt -= scaledDelta;\n        }\n        totalScaledDebt -= scaledDelta;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Largest debt one liquidation may repay. Normally the close factor, but a\n    ///      full close is allowed when the close factor would leave dust behind, or\n    ///      when the position is underwater (collateral value no longer covers debt).\n    function _maxLiquidatableDebt(uint256 debt, uint256 collateralValue) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 capped = Math.mulDiv(debt, closeFactorBps, BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        if (collateralValue <= debt) return debt;\n        if (debt - capped < minBorrow) return debt;\n        return capped;\n    }\n\n    function _requireWithinLtv(Position storage position, uint256 index) internal view {\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) return;\n\n        uint256 collateralValue =\n            _collateralToDebt(position.collateral, oracle.getPrice(), Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        uint256 maxDebt = Math.mulDiv(collateralValue, ltvBps, BPS, Math.Rounding.Floor);\n        if (debt > maxDebt) revert PositionUnhealthy(debt, maxDebt);\n    }\n\n    function _maxWithdrawable(Position storage position, uint256 index) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 collateral = position.collateral;\n        uint256 debt = _debtOf(position, index);\n        if (debt == 0) return collateral;\n\n        // Collateral value that must stay behind to keep debt within LTV, rounded up.\n        uint256 requiredValue = Math.mulDiv(debt, BPS, ltvBps, Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        uint256 requiredCollateral = _debtToCollateral(requiredValue, oracle.getPrice(), Math.Rounding.Ceil);\n        return collateral > requiredCollateral ? collateral - requiredCollateral : 0;\n    }\n\n    function _availableLiquidity() internal view returns (uint256) {\n        return debtToken.balanceOf(address(this));\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Collateral units -> debt-token units at `price` (USD per whole collateral token, 1e18).\n    function _collateralToDebt(uint256 amount, uint256 price, Math.Rounding rounding)\n        internal\n        view\n        returns (uint256)\n    {\n        if (amount == 0) return 0;\n        uint256 usd = Math.mulDiv(amount, price, PRICE_SCALE, rounding);\n        return Math.mulDiv(usd, _debtUnit, _collateralUnit, rounding);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Debt-token units -> collateral units. Inverse of `_collateralToDebt`.\n    function _debtToCollateral(uint256 amount, uint256 price, Math.Rounding rounding)\n        internal\n        view\n        returns (uint256)\n    {\n        if (amount == 0) return 0;\n        uint256 usd = Math.mulDiv(amount, _collateralUnit, _debtUnit, rounding);\n        return Math.mulDiv(usd, PRICE_SCALE, price, rounding);\n    }\n\n    /* ----------------------------- param setters ----------------------------- */\n\n    function _setOracle(address oracle_) private {\n        if (oracle_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        // Fail fast on a feed that cannot serve a price at all.\n        if (IPriceOracle(oracle_).getPrice() == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        oracle = IPriceOracle(oracle_);\n        emit OracleSet(oracle_);\n    }\n\n    function _setRiskParams(uint256 ltvBps_, uint256 thresholdBps_, uint256 bonusBps_, uint256 closeFactorBps_)\n        private\n    {\n        if (ltvBps_ == 0 || ltvBps_ >= thresholdBps_) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n        if (thresholdBps_ >= BPS) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n        if (bonusBps_ == 0 || bonusBps_ > MAX_LIQUIDATION_BONUS_BPS) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n        if (closeFactorBps_ == 0 || closeFactorBps_ > BPS) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n        // A position liquidated right at the threshold must still be able to pay the\n        // bonus out of its own collateral, i.e. threshold * (1 + bonus) <= 100%.\n        if (thresholdBps_ * (BPS + bonusBps_) > BPS * BPS) revert InvalidRiskParams();\n\n        ltvBps = ltvBps_;\n        liquidationThresholdBps = thresholdBps_;\n        liquidationBonusBps = bonusBps_;\n        closeFactorBps = closeFactorBps_;\n        emit RiskParamsSet(ltvBps_, thresholdBps_, bonusBps_, closeFactorBps_);\n    }\n\n    function _setInterestRate(uint256 interestRateBps_) private {\n        if (interestRateBps_ > MAX_INTEREST_RATE_BPS) revert InvalidInterestRate();\n        interestRateBps = interestRateBps_;\n        emit InterestRateSet(interestRateBps_);\n    }\n\n    function _setMinBorrow(uint256 minBorrow_) private {\n        minBorrow = minBorrow_;\n        emit MinBorrowSet(minBorrow_);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}
