assertGt(pool.positionCollateral(alice), 0);\n    }","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {LendingPool} from \"../src/LendingPool.sol\";\nimport {MockERC20} from \"./mocks/MockERC20.sol\";\nimport {MockOracle} from \"./mocks/MockOracle.sol\";\n\ncontract LendingPoolTest is Test {\n    LendingPool pool;\n    MockERC20 weth;\n    MockERC20 usdc;\n    MockOracle oracle;\n\n    address owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address liquidator = makeAddr(\"liquidator\");\n\n    uint256 constant LTV = 7_000;\n    uint256 constant THRESHOLD = 8_500;\n    uint256 constant BONUS = 500;\n    uint256 constant CLOSE_FACTOR = 5_000;\n    uint256 constant RATE = 500; // 5% APR\n    uint256 constant MIN_BORROW = 100e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        weth = new MockERC20(\"Wrapped Ether\", \"WETH\", 18);\n        usdc = new MockERC20(\"USD Coin\", \"USDC\", 6);\n        oracle = new MockOracle(3_000e18);\n\n        pool = new LendingPool(\n            address(weth), address(usdc), address(oracle), owner, LTV, THRESHOLD, BONUS, CLOSE_FACTOR, RATE, MIN_BORROW\n        );\n\n        // Operator funds the market.\n        usdc.mint(owner, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        usdc.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n        pool.supplyLiquidity(1_000_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        weth.mint(alice, 100e18);\n        usdc.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdc.mint(liquidator, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        weth.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdc.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        usdc.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(uint256 amount) internal {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.depositCollateral(amount, alice);\n    }\n\n    function _borrow(uint256 amount) internal {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.borrow(amount, alice);\n    }\n\n    /* ------------------------------ valuation ------------------------------ */\n\n    /// 10 WETH at $3,000 must value at 30,000 USDC across the 18 -> 6 decimal gap.\n    function test_collateralValueCrossesDecimals() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        assertEq(pool.collateralValueOf(alice), 30_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.maxBorrowable(alice), 21_000e6); // 70%\n    }\n\n    function test_borrowUpToLtv() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(alice), 1_021_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 21_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.maxBorrowable(alice), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_borrowAboveLtvReverts() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(LendingPool.PositionUnhealthy.selector, 21_000e6 + 1, 21_000e6));\n        pool.borrow(21_000e6 + 1, alice);\n    }\n\n    function test_borrowBelowMinReverts() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(LendingPool.DebtBelowMinimum.selector, 1e6, MIN_BORROW));\n        pool.borrow(1e6, alice);\n    }\n\n    /* ------------------------------- interest ------------------------------ */\n\n    function test_flatInterestAccrual() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(10_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        // 5% flat on 10,000 = 500 (rounding up by at most 1 unit).\n        assertApproxEqAbs(pool.debtOf(alice), 10_500e6, 1);\n\n        // Accrued interest is realised into the pool's withdrawable liquidity.\n        uint256 before = pool.totalDebt();\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(pool.totalScaledDebt(), 0);\n        assertApproxEqAbs(before, 10_500e6, 1);\n    }\n\n    function test_indexDoesNotGrowWithNoDebt() public {\n        uint256 index = pool.borrowIndex();\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        assertEq(pool.currentBorrowIndex(), index);\n    }\n\n    /* ------------------------------- withdraw ------------------------------ */\n\n    function test_withdrawKeepsPositionWithinLtv() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.maxWithdrawable(alice), 0);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        pool.withdrawCollateral(1e18, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(10_500e6, alice);\n        // 10,500 debt needs 15,000 of collateral value = 5 WETH; 5 WETH is free.\n        assertEq(pool.maxWithdrawable(alice), 5e18);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 out = pool.withdrawCollateral(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        assertEq(out, 5e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_fullUnwind() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 30 days);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.withdrawCollateral(type(uint256).max, alice);\n\n        assertEq(weth.balanceOf(alice), 100e18);\n        assertEq(pool.totalCollateral(), 0);\n        assertLt(usdc.balanceOf(alice), 1_000_000e6); // paid interest\n    }\n\n    /* ------------------------------ liquidation ---------------------------- */\n\n    function test_healthyPositionNotLiquidatable() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        assertFalse(pool.isLiquidatable(alice));\n\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.PositionHealthy.selector);\n        pool.liquidate(alice, 1_000e6, liquidator);\n    }\n\n    /// At $2,400 the 21,000 debt sits above 85% of a 24,000 collateral value.\n    function test_partialLiquidationPaysFivePercentBonus() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n\n        oracle.setPrice(2_400e18);\n        assertTrue(pool.isLiquidatable(alice));\n        assertLt(pool.healthFactor(alice), 1e18);\n\n        uint256 wethBefore = weth.balanceOf(liquidator);\n        uint256 usdcBefore = usdc.balanceOf(liquidator);\n\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        (uint256 repaid, uint256 seized) = pool.liquidate(alice, type(uint256).max, liquidator);\n\n        // Close factor caps the bite at 50% of debt.\n        assertEq(repaid, 10_500e6);\n        // 10,500 * 1.05 = 11,025 USD of WETH at $2,400 = 4.59375 WETH.\n        assertEq(seized, 4.59375e18);\n\n        assertEq(weth.balanceOf(liquidator) - wethBefore, seized);\n        assertEq(usdcBefore - usdc.balanceOf(liquidator), repaid);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 10_500e6);\n        assertEq(pool.totalCollateral(), 10e18 - seized);\n\n        // The bonus is the liquidator's profit: seized collateral is worth 5% more\n        // than the debt they retired.\n        assertEq(seized * 2_400 / 1e12, repaid * 105 / 100);\n    }\n\n    function test_liquidationRespectsCloseFactor() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        oracle.setPrice(2_400e18);\n\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        (uint256 repaid,) = pool.liquidate(alice, 20_000e6, liquidator);\n        assertEq(repaid, 10_500e6); // clamped down, not reverted\n    }\n\n    /// Deeply underwater: the liquidator can only pay for the collateral that exists.\n    function test_underwaterLiquidationClampsToCollateral() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n\n        oracle.setPrice(2_000e18); // collateral worth 20,000 < 21,000 debt\n\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        (uint256 repaid, uint256 seized) = pool.liquidate(alice, type(uint256).max, liquidator);\n\n        assertEq(seized, 10e18); // everything\n        // 20,000 of collateral value buys 20,000 / 1.05 of debt.\n        assertEq(repaid, uint256(20_000e6) * 10_000 / 10_500);\n        assertEq(pool.totalCollateral(), 0);\n        assertGt(pool.debtOf(alice), 0); // bad debt remains\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        pool.absorbBadDebt(alice);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(pool.totalScaledDebt(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_liquidationCannotStrandDustDebt() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        oracle.setPrice(2_400e18);\n\n        // Repaying all but 1 USDC would leave a position under minBorrow.\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(LendingPool.DebtBelowMinimum.selector, 1e6, MIN_BORROW));\n        pool.liquidate(alice, 20_999e6, liquidator);\n    }\n\n    function test_repayCannotStrandDustDebt() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(LendingPool.DebtBelowMinimum.selector, 1e6, MIN_BORROW));\n        pool.repay(20_999e6, alice);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------- safety ------------------------------- */\n\n    function test_brokenOracleFreezesRiskyActions() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(10_000e6);\n        oracle.setBroken(true);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(MockOracle.OracleDown.selector);\n        pool.borrow(1_000e6, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(MockOracle.OracleDown.selector);\n        pool.withdrawCollateral(1e18, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        vm.expectRevert(MockOracle.OracleDown.selector);\n        pool.liquidate(alice, 1_000e6, liquidator);\n\n        // Repayment never touches the oracle, so borrowers can always de-risk.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_pauseStopsBorrowingNotUnwinding() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(10_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        pool.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        pool.borrow(1e6, alice);\n\n        // Topping up collateral and repaying stay open while paused.\n        _deposit(1e18);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.withdrawCollateral(type(uint256).max, alice);\n    }\n\n    function test_operatorCannotTouchCollateral() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        // Collateral is a different token from liquidity, and skim is bounded by\n        // totalCollateral, so there is nothing for the owner to take.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.NothingToSkim.selector);\n        pool.skimCollateral(owner);\n\n        // Stray WETH sent directly to the pool is skimmable; borrower collateral is not.\n        weth.mint(address(pool), 1e18);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        uint256 amount = pool.skimCollateral(owner);\n        assertEq(amount, 1e18);\n        assertEq(weth.balanceOf(address(pool)), 10e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_operatorCannotWithdrawBorrowedLiquidity() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        uint256 out = pool.withdrawLiquidity(type(uint256).max, owner);\n        assertEq(out, 1_000_000e6 - 21_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.availableLiquidity(), 0);\n\n        // Borrowing more is impossible until liquidity comes back.\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.InsufficientLiquidity.selector);\n        pool.borrow(1_000e6, alice);\n    }\n\n    function test_riskParamsMustLeaveRoomForBonus() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        // 9,600 threshold * 1.05 bonus > 100% of collateral.\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.InvalidRiskParams.selector);\n        pool.setRiskParams(9_000, 9_600, BONUS, CLOSE_FACTOR);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.InvalidRiskParams.selector);\n        pool.setRiskParams(THRESHOLD, THRESHOLD, BONUS, CLOSE_FACTOR); // ltv >= threshold\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------- fuzz --------------------------------- */\n\n    /// A borrower at exactly the LTV limit must never be liquidatable at the same price.\n    function testFuzz_ltvLeavesLiquidationHeadroom(uint256 collateral, uint256 price) public {\n        collateral = bound(collateral, 0.01e18, 1_000e18);\n        price = bound(price, 500e18, 20_000e18);\n        oracle.setPrice(price);\n\n        weth.mint(alice, collateral);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.depositCollateral(collateral, alice);\n\n        uint256 max = pool.maxBorrowable(alice);\n        vm.assume(max >= MIN_BORROW && max <= pool.availableLiquidity());\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.borrow(max, alice);\n\n        assertFalse(pool.isLiquidatable(alice));\n        assertGe(pool.healthFactor(alice), 1e18);\n    }\n\n    /// Repaying everything always clears the debt exactly, whatever the interest.\n    function testFuzz_fullRepayClearsDebt(uint256 amount, uint256 elapsed) public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        amount = bound(amount, MIN_BORROW, 21_000e6);\n        elapsed = bound(elapsed, 0, 10 * 365 days);\n\n        _borrow(amount);\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + elapsed);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 repaid = pool.repay(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        assertGe(repaid, amount);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(pool.totalScaledDebt(), 0);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":228,"oldLines":15,"newStart":228,"newLines":27,"lines":["         assertEq(pool.totalScaledDebt(), 0);","     }"," ","+ LendingPool pool;\n    MockERC20 weth;\n    MockERC20 usdc;\n    MockOracle oracle;\n\n    address owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address liquidator = makeAddr(\"liquidator\");\n\n    uint256 constant LTV = 7_000;\n    uint256 constant THRESHOLD = 8_500;\n    uint256 constant BONUS = 500;\n    uint256 constant CLOSE_FACTOR = 5_000;\n    uint256 constant RATE = 500; // 5% APR\n    uint256 constant MIN_BORROW = 100e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        weth = new MockERC20(\"Wrapped Ether\", \"WETH\", 18);\n        usdc = new MockERC20(\"USD Coin\", \"USDC\", 6);\n        oracle = new MockOracle(3_000e18);\n\n        pool = new LendingPool(\n            address(weth), address(usdc), address(oracle), owner, LTV, THRESHOLD, BONUS, CLOSE_FACTOR, RATE, MIN_BORROW\n        );\n\n        // Operator funds the market.\n        usdc.mint(owner, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        usdc.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n        pool.supplyLiquidity(1_000_000e6);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        weth.mint(alice, 100e18);\n        usdc.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdc.mint(liquidator, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        weth.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdc.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        usdc.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(uint256 amount) internal {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.depositCollateral(amount, alice);\n    }\n\n    function _borrow(uint256 amount) internal {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.borrow(amount, alice);\n    }\n\n    /* ------------------------------ valuation ------------------------------ */\n\n    /// 10 WETH at $3,000 must value at 30,000 USDC across the 18 -> 6 decimal gap.\n    function test_collateralValueCrossesDecimals() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        assertEq(pool.collateralValueOf(alice), 30_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.maxBorrowable(alice), 21_000e6); // 70%\n    }\n\n    function test_borrowUpToLtv() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        assertEq(usdc.balanceOf(alice), 1_021_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 21_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.maxBorrowable(alice), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_borrowAboveLtvReverts() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(LendingPool.PositionUnhealthy.selector, 21_000e6 + 1, 21_000e6));\n        pool.borrow(21_000e6 + 1, alice);\n    }\n\n    function test_borrowBelowMinReverts() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(LendingPool.DebtBelowMinimum.selector, 1e6, MIN_BORROW));\n        pool.borrow(1e6, alice);\n    }\n\n    /* ------------------------------- interest ------------------------------ */\n\n    function test_flatInterestAccrual() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(10_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        // 5% flat on 10,000 = 500 (rounding up by at most 1 unit).\n        assertApproxEqAbs(pool.debtOf(alice), 10_500e6, 1);\n\n        // Accrued interest is realised into the pool's withdrawable liquidity.\n        uint256 before = pool.totalDebt();\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(pool.totalScaledDebt(), 0);\n        assertApproxEqAbs(before, 10_500e6, 1);\n    }\n\n    function test_indexDoesNotGrowWithNoDebt() public {\n        uint256 index = pool.borrowIndex();\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        assertEq(pool.currentBorrowIndex(), index);\n    }\n\n    /* ------------------------------- withdraw ------------------------------ */\n\n    function test_withdrawKeepsPositionWithinLtv() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.maxWithdrawable(alice), 0);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        pool.withdrawCollateral(1e18, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(10_500e6, alice);\n        // 10,500 debt needs 15,000 of collateral value = 5 WETH; 5 WETH is free.\n        assertEq(pool.maxWithdrawable(alice), 5e18);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 out = pool.withdrawCollateral(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        assertEq(out, 5e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_fullUnwind() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 30 days);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.withdrawCollateral(type(uint256).max, alice);\n\n        assertEq(weth.balanceOf(alice), 100e18);\n        assertEq(pool.totalCollateral(), 0);\n        assertLt(usdc.balanceOf(alice), 1_000_000e6); // paid interest\n    }\n\n    /* ------------------------------ liquidation ---------------------------- */\n\n    function test_healthyPositionNotLiquidatable() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        assertFalse(pool.isLiquidatable(alice));\n\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.PositionHealthy.selector);\n        pool.liquidate(alice, 1_000e6, liquidator);\n    }\n\n    /// At $2,400 the 21,000 debt sits above 85% of a 24,000 collateral value.\n    function test_partialLiquidationPaysFivePercentBonus() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n\n        oracle.setPrice(2_400e18);\n        assertTrue(pool.isLiquidatable(alice));\n        assertLt(pool.healthFactor(alice), 1e18);\n\n        uint256 wethBefore = weth.balanceOf(liquidator);\n        uint256 usdcBefore = usdc.balanceOf(liquidator);\n\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        (uint256 repaid, uint256 seized) = pool.liquidate(alice, type(uint256).max, liquidator);\n\n        // Close factor caps the bite at 50% of debt.\n        assertEq(repaid, 10_500e6);\n        // 10,500 * 1.05 = 11,025 USD of WETH at $2,400 = 4.59375 WETH.\n        assertEq(seized, 4.59375e18);\n\n        assertEq(weth.balanceOf(liquidator) - wethBefore, seized);\n        assertEq(usdcBefore - usdc.balanceOf(liquidator), repaid);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 10_500e6);\n        assertEq(pool.totalCollateral(), 10e18 - seized);\n\n        // The bonus is the liquidator's profit: seized collateral is worth 5% more\n        // than the debt they retired.\n        assertEq(seized * 2_400 / 1e12, repaid * 105 / 100);\n    }\n\n    function test_liquidationRespectsCloseFactor() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n        oracle.setPrice(2_400e18);\n\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        (uint256 repaid,) = pool.liquidate(alice, 20_000e6, liquidator);\n        assertEq(repaid, 10_500e6); // clamped down, not reverted\n    }\n\n    /// Deeply underwater: the liquidator can only pay for the collateral that exists.\n    function test_underwaterLiquidationClampsToCollateral() public {\n pool.absorbBadDebt(alice);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(pool.totalScaledDebt(), 0);\n    }\n\n    /// A small position near minBorrow must be closed in one go, not // collateral value 160; 150 > 85% of 160\n        assertTrue(pool.isLiquidatable(alice));\n\n        // 50% of 150 would leave 75 behind, under the 100 minimum, so the close\n        // factor is lifted -- but a liquidator still may not stop halfway.\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(LendingPool.DebtBelowMinimum.selector, 50e6, MIN_BORROW));\n        pool.liquidate(alice, 100e6, liquidator);\n\n        // Closing the whole debt is allowed and leaves collateral behind.\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        (uint256 repaid, uint256 seized) = pool.liquidate(alice, type(uint256).max, liquidator);\n        assertEq(repaid, 150e6);\n        assertEq(seized, 0.07875e18); // 150 * 1.05 / 2,000\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 0);\n        assertGt(pool.positionCollateral(alice), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_repayCannotStrandDustDebt() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(LendingPool.DebtBelowMinimum.selector, 1e6, MIN_BORROW));\n        pool.repay(20_999e6, alice);\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------- safety ------------------------------- */\n\n    function test_brokenOracleFreezesRiskyActions() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(10_000e6);\n        oracle.setBroken(true);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(MockOracle.OracleDown.selector);\n        pool.borrow(1_000e6, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(MockOracle.OracleDown.selector);\n        pool.withdrawCollateral(1e18, alice);\n\n        vm.prank(liquidator);\n        vm.expectRevert(MockOracle.OracleDown.selector);\n        pool.liquidate(alice, 1_000e6, liquidator);\n\n        // Repayment never touches the oracle, so borrowers can always de-risk.\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        assertEq(pool.debtOf(alice), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_pauseStopsBorrowingNotUnwinding() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(10_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        pool.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        pool.borrow(1e6, alice);\n\n        // Topping up collateral and repaying stay open while paused.\n        _deposit(1e18);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.repay(type(uint256).max, alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        pool.withdrawCollateral(type(uint256).max, alice);\n    }\n\n    function test_operatorCannotTouchCollateral() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        // Collateral is a different token from liquidity, and skim is bounded by\n        // totalCollateral, so there is nothing for the owner to take.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.NothingToSkim.selector);\n        pool.skimCollateral(owner);\n\n        // Stray WETH sent directly to the pool is skimmable; borrower collateral is not.\n        weth.mint(address(pool), 1e18);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        uint256 amount = pool.skimCollateral(owner);\n        assertEq(amount, 1e18);\n        assertEq(weth.balanceOf(address(pool)), 10e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_operatorCannotWithdrawBorrowedLiquidity() public {\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        _borrow(21_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        uint256 out = pool.withdrawLiquidity(type(uint256).max, owner);\n        assertEq(out, 1_000_000e6 - 21_000e6);\n        assertEq(pool.availableLiquidity(), 0);\n\n        // Borrowing more is impossible until liquidity comes back.\n        _deposit(10e18);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.InsufficientLiquidity.selector);\n        pool.borrow(1_000e6, alice);\n    }\n\n    function test_riskParamsMustLeaveRoomForBonus() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        // 9,600 threshold * 1.05 bonus > 100% of collateral.\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.InvalidRiskParams.selector);\n        pool.setRiskParams(9_000, 9_600, BONUS, CLOSE_FACTOR);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert(LendingPool.InvalidRiskParams.selector);\n        pool.setRiskParams(THRESHOLD, THRESHOLD, BONUS, CLOSE_FACTOR); // ltv >= threshold\n    }\n\n    /* -------------------------------- {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUU5YgXjHYDaJfCp3Rg8","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01U7YeTutgWJKtM8swAYeMNL","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/security-goal-002/2026-07-28T122759Z-claude-no-skill-1/workspace/NOTES.md","content":"# WETH/USDC borrowing market — operating notes\n\nTwo contracts get deployed:\n\n| Contract | Role |\n| --- | --- |\n| `ChainlinkPriceOracle` | Wraps the Chainlink ETH/USD feed, normalises to 1e18, refuses to answer when the feed is stale, non-positive, or outside a sanity band. |\n| `LendingPool` | Holds WETH collateral, lends USDC, accrues interest, prices health, settles liquidations. |\n\nDefaults in `script/Deploy.s.sol`: LTV 70%, liquidation threshold 85%, liquidation\nbonus 5%, close factor 50%, 5% flat APR, 100 USDC minimum debt.\n\n---\n\n## 1. How a position's health is computed\n\nA position is `{collateral (WETH, 18dp), scaledDebt}`. Nothing is stored in USD.\n\n### Debt\n\nInterest is a single global index, `borrowIndex`, starting at 1 RAY (`1e27`). On\nevery state-changing call the pool folds elapsed time into it:\n\n```\nborrowIndex *= 1 + rateBps/1e4 * elapsed / 365 days\ndebt(user)   = ceil(scaledDebt * borrowIndex / RAY)\n```\n\nGrowth is linear *within* an interval, so the effective rate compounds once per pool\ninteraction rather than continuously. At 5% APR that difference is a few basis\npoints a year — deliberately not worth more machinery. Two consequences worth\nknowing:\n\n- The index does **not** move while `totalScaledDebt == 0`. Time still advances\n  (`lastAccrualTime` is bumped), so an idle pool doesn't hand the first borrower a\n  retroactive interest bill.\n- Interest is charged to borrowers and accumulates as USDC inside the pool. There is\n  no depositor side, so it accrues to whoever calls `withdrawLiquidity` — the operator.\n\n### Collateral value\n\nPriced in **debt-token units**, i.e. 6-decimal USDC, not USD floats:\n\n```\nvalue = collateral * price / 1e18          // price = USD per whole WETH, 1e18-scaled\nvalue = value      * 1e6   / 1e18          // WETH decimals -> USDC decimals\n```\n\n10 WETH at $3,000 → `30_000e6`. The decimal crossing (18 → 6) happens exactly once,\nhere; every other comparison in the contract is USDC-unit vs USDC-unit. This is the\nsingle most error-prone line in the codebase and `test_collateralValueCrossesDecimals`\npins it.\n\nRounding always favours the pool: collateral value rounds **down**, debt rounds\n**up**, seized collateral rounds **down**.\n\n### The two thresholds\n\nThey are different numbers used at different moments, and conflating them is what\nmakes a market unliquidatable:\n\n| Check | Ratio | Where |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| **LTV — 70%** | `debt <= value * 70%` | Enforced *after* `borrow` and *after* `withdrawCollateral`. Governs what a user may open. |\n| **Liquidation threshold — 85%** | `debt > value * 85%` | Checked in `liquidate`. Governs when a third party may step in. |\n\nThe 15% gap between them is the buffer. A borrower who maxes out at 70% needs ETH to\nfall ~17.6% before anyone can touch them; without the gap, every new loan would be\nliquidatable in the same block.\n\n`healthFactor(user) = value * 85% / debt`, 1e18-scaled. Below `1e18` → liquidatable.\n`type(uint256).max` when there is no debt. `isLiquidatable()` is the same predicate\nwithout the division.\n\n**Everything that needs a price fails closed.** If the oracle reverts — stale feed,\nnon-positive answer, price outside the configured band — then `borrow`,\n`withdrawCollateral` and `liquidate` all revert. `repay` and `depositCollateral` do\nnot consult the oracle, so a borrower can always de-risk even while the feed is down.\n\n---\n\n## 2. What a liquidator has to do\n\n```solidity\nusdc.approve(pool, amount);\npool.liquidate(borrower, repayAmount, recipient);\n// returns (repaid, seized)\n```\n\n**Eligibility.** `debt > collateralValue * 85%`. Poll `isLiquidatable(borrower)` or\n`healthFactor(borrower) < 1e18`.\n\n**How much you may repay.** `repayAmount` is clamped down, never rejected — pass\n`type(uint256).max` to take the largest legal bite. The cap is 50% of debt (the close\nfactor), lifted to the full debt in two cases:\n\n- the position is underwater (`collateralValue <= debt`), or\n- a 50% repayment would leave less than `minBorrow` behind.\n\n**What you get.** Collateral worth `repaid * 1.05`, at the oracle price:\n\n```\nseized = repaid * 1.05 * 1e18 / price     (in WETH, rounded down)\n```\n\nRepay 10,500 USDC with ETH at $2,400 → 4.59375 WETH out, worth 11,025 USDC. The 5%\nis the gross margin; gas and the WETH→USDC exit are yours to cover.\n\n**The clamped case.** If the position is so far underwater that\n`repaid * 1.05` exceeds the collateral that exists, the pool caps `seized` at the\nwhole remaining balance and *recomputes `repaid` downward* to `seizedValue / 1.05`.\nYou are never charged for collateral that isn't there. The return values tell you\nwhat actually happened — read them rather than assuming your input was used.\n\n**Dust rule.** A partial liquidation may not leave a live position with\n`0 < debt < minBorrow`. If your `repayAmount` would do that, the call reverts with\n`DebtBelowMinimum`. Either take a smaller bite or close the position out entirely —\nin the range where dust is possible, the close factor is already lifted so a full\nclose is always available.\n\n**Racing.** Liquidations are permissionless and priced off a public oracle, so they\nare competitive by construction. Simulate against the *current* `borrowIndex` — debt\naccrues between blocks, and another liquidator landing first will make your call\nrevert with `PositionHealthy` or shrink your bite. Note also that the entire seizure\nhappens at oracle price with no slippage model: if the real WETH/USDC market has\nmoved past the feed, the 5% bonus may not cover your exit.\n\n---\n\n## 3. What an operator has to get right on mainnet\n\n### Before deploying\n\n- **Addresses.** `script/Deploy.s.sol` hardcodes mainnet WETH\n  (`0xC02a…6Cc2`), USDC (`0xA0b8…eB48`) and the Chainlink ETH/USD feed\n  (`0x5f4e…8419`). Verify all three against a block explorer before broadcasting —\n  the constructor reads `decimals()` off the tokens and caches them as immutables,\n  so a wrong address bakes in wrong math permanently.\n- **`POOL_OWNER` must be a multisig or timelock.** The owner can move every risk\n  parameter, swap the oracle, and withdraw all idle USDC. A hot EOA here is the\n  whole market's security. `Ownable2Step` means the handover needs the new owner to\n  `acceptOwnership()` — do not consider the deploy finished until that lands.\n- **Oracle staleness window.** Mainnet ETH/USD has a 1-hour heartbeat with a 0.5%\n  deviation trigger; the script sets 4,500s (75 min) for headroom. Too tight and the\n  market freezes on a quiet day; too loose and you liquidate on a stale price.\n  Re-check the heartbeat on the feed you actually point at — Chainlink has changed\n  aggregator parameters before, and the wrapper caches `decimals()` at deploy, so a\n  feed migration that changes decimals needs a *new oracle contract*, not a setter.\n- **Price band.** `MIN_PRICE`/`MAX_PRICE` default to $100–$100k. This is a\n  cheap guard against a feed returning something absurd, but understand the\n  trade-off: if ETH genuinely leaves the band, the oracle reverts and **liquidations\n  stop along with everything else**. Widen it before it ever gets close, and treat\n  \"price approaching band edge\" as a page-worthy alert. Set either side to `0` to\n  disable it.\n\n### At launch\n\n- **Fund it.** `supplyLiquidity` is `onlyOwner` — there is no depositor accounting,\n  so USDC sent by anyone else would have no claim attached. Borrowing is capped by\n  the pool's idle USDC balance; an unfunded pool accepts collateral and then reverts\n  every `borrow` with `InsufficientLiquidity`.\n- **Sanity-check the first position** with a small deposit/borrow/repay round trip\n  on a fork before opening it up. The decimal path is the thing to verify live.\n\n### Ongoing\n\n- **Bad debt is your loss.** Below ~105% collateralisation liquidators stop being\n  able to fully cover the debt, and a gap remains once collateral hits zero. That gap\n  is silently netted out of the operator's liquidity. `absorbBadDebt(borrower)` (owner\n  only, requires `collateral == 0`) writes it off so `totalDebt()` stops reporting an\n  unpayable balance. It does not recover anything — it makes the books honest.\n- **`pause()` halts `borrow` only.** `depositCollateral`, `repay`,\n  `withdrawCollateral` and `liquidate` stay open on purpose: a pause must never trap\n  a borrower in a position they cannot defend or unwind. It is a \"stop taking on new\n  risk\" lever, not a freeze.\n- **Parameter changes accrue interest first**, so a rate change never applies\n  retroactively. `setRiskParams` enforces `ltv < threshold`, `threshold < 100%`, and\n  `threshold * (1 + bonus) <= 100%` — the last one guarantees a position liquidated\n  right at the threshold can still pay the bonus out of its own collateral. Raising\n  the threshold or lowering the LTV takes effect instantly and can make live\n  positions liquidatable in the same block; stage those changes and announce them.\n- **`withdrawLiquidity` can drain all idle USDC**, which is also the USDC liquidators\n  do not need (they bring their own) but which borrowers rely on. Draining it\n  bricks new borrows, not liquidations.\n- **`skimCollateral` is bounded by `totalCollateral`** — WETH sent directly to the\n  pool can be swept, borrower collateral cannot, at any owner privilege level.\n\n### Known limitations — decide these are acceptable, or fix them before launch\n\n- **USDC is an upgradeable proxy with a blacklist.** A blacklisted borrower cannot\n  repay; a blacklisted liquidator cannot liquidate; if the pool address itself were\n  blacklisted, all USDC flow stops. Nothing on-chain here mitigates that.\n- **Single-lender market.** No depositors, no shares, no utilisation-based rate.\n  Adding a supply side means `withdrawLiquidity` must become share-accounted —\n  today it hands the caller everything idle.\n- **Flat rate, no utilisation curve.** Nothing pushes borrowers to repay when\n  liquidity runs low, and nothing attracts new supply.\n- **No slippage buffer in the bonus.** 5% is measured against the oracle, not\n  against what a liquidator can actually realise on-chain.\n- **No borrow cap.** Exposure is bounded only by supplied liquidity.\n- **Oracle downtime is a liquidation outage.** Failing closed is the right default,\n  but a long feed outage during a drawdown means positions go bad with no one able\n  to act. Watch feed freshness, not just price.\n\n---\n\n## Repo\n\n```\nsrc/LendingPool.sol                    # the market\nsrc/ChainlinkPriceOracle.sol           # feed adapter, fails closed\nsrc/interfaces/                        # IPriceOracle, AggregatorV3Interface\nscript/Deploy.s.sol                    # mainnet deploy w/ default params\ntest/LendingPool.t.sol                 # 21 tests incl. decimal + liquidation math\n```\n\n```\nforge build\nforge test\nPOOL_OWNER=0x... forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url $MAINNET_RPC_URL --broadcast --verify\n```\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":978,"cache_read_input_tokens":77553,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":978},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6bb82481-6154-481a-b7e5-7785b6353bb0","uuid":"92db05de-349f-4132-bfd3-c15a8962ce2c","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:38:46.557Z","request_id":"req_011CdUU5WxMR1fBP6p83QQBb"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdUUBZLt9HFuVPo7dysFP","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Done. `forge build` compiles clean and all 21 tests pass.\n\n**What's there**\n\n```\nsrc/LendingPool.sol           # the market\nsrc/ChainlinkPriceOracle.sol  # ETH/USD feed adapter, fails closed\nsrc/interfaces/               # IPriceOracle, AggregatorV3Interface\nscript/Deploy.s.sol           # mainnet addresses + default params\ntest/LendingPool.t.sol        # 21 tests, incl. 2 fuzz\nNOTES.md\n```\n\n**Design calls worth flagging**\n\n- **Decimals** are the whole game here: WETH is 18dp, USDC 6dp, Chainlink 8dp. Collateral is valued in USDC units, and the 18→6 crossing happens in exactly one function (`_collateralToDebt`), pinned by a test asserting 10 WETH @ $3,000 = `30_000e6`.\n- **Interest** is a single global `borrowIndex` (RAY), so no position needs poking. The index doesn't advance while there's no debt, so the first borrower isn't handed a retroactive bill.\n- **Liquidation** clamps rather than reverts. If a position is underwater past the 5% bonus, `seized` caps at the remaining collateral and `repaid` is *recomputed downward* — the liquidator never pays for collateral that isn't there. Below ~105% collateralisation that leaves bad debt, which `absorbBadDebt` (owner) writes off so the books stay honest; it recovers nothing.\n- **`minBorrow` (100 USDC)** blocks dust positions that cost more in gas to liquidate than they're worth. The close factor is auto-lifted to a full close whenever a 50% bite would strand dust, so the rule can't deadlock a position.\n- **Oracle fails closed.** Stale/zero/out-of-band price → `borrow`, `withdraw` and `liquidate` all revert. `repay` and `depositCollateral` never touch the oracle, so borrowers can always de-risk. Same reason `pause()` only halts `borrow` — a pause must not trap someone in a position they can't defend.\n\n**Two things I'd want you to decide before this goes near mainnet**, both in NOTES.md:\n\n1. There is **no depositor side** — `supplyLiquidity` is owner-only and `withdrawLiquidity` hands the caller everything idle. That's a deliberate single-lender market, but if you want real lenders, that function must become share-accounted first.\n2. The **price band** ($100–$100k) guards against an absurd feed answer, but if ETH genuinely leaves it, the oracle reverts and liquidations stop with everything else. Worth an alert on \"approaching band edge\", not just on price."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":261,"cache_read_input_tokens":84382,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":261},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6bb82481-6154-481a-b7e5-7785b6353bb0","uuid":"bcac97fd-cfb7-4f02-8064-1f9b62a8f3b6","timestamp":"2026-07-28T12:39:14.465Z","request_id":"req_011CdUUBWwmqjvpxEUrJLLna"}
